purpose: Teach: ヒデ/オト/ヨハネ/チャールズ/アラン/エホバ/トーマス/ケリー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがX JAPANのヒデの曲をご愛聴された
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he really loved X Japan — Hide's music especially.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft voice, looking inward at the memory. Slow, deliberate pace. Trails off slightly at the end, as if turning the thought over in his mind.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お孫様にオトちゃんって愛称を付けられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and you gave your grandson that nickname — Oto-chan, didn't you dear?
lines.style: Warm, teasing affection. Quick, playful rhythm. Slight tilt of the head — she's caught him mid-reverie and knows it. Gentle emphasis on the nickname, voice brightening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが聖ヨハネ教会の歴史に詳しかった
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he was quite knowledgeable about the history of St. John's Church.
lines.style: Same nostalgic timbre as the first line. Quieter, more introspective. Pauses slightly before the second clause, as if fishing for the memory. Wistful trailing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、英国でチャールズ皇太子をご覧になられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you saw Prince Charles in England, didn't you dear?
lines.style: Playful redirect. She's gently steering him back to his own stories. Lighter tone, almost mischievous. Rhythmic, knowingly affectionate — she's done this dance before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアラン・ドロンの映画を観られた
lines.en: When your father was young, he watched Alan Delon films quite often.
lines.style: Softer still. Voice becomes more distant, dreamlike. Each phrase deliberate, with small pauses between them. The wistfulness deepens — this is an older memory, hazier.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、エホバの証人の方々と対話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You had such interesting conversations with the Jehovah's Witnesses back then, didn't you dear?
lines.style: Knowing warmth. She's gently mocking his seriousness from years past. Measured pace, each word clear. Fond emphasis on 'such interesting conversations' — affectionate teasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが我が子に機関車トーマスの絵本を読まれた
lines.en: When your father was young, he read his children picture books — Thomas the Tank Engine, if I remember right.
lines.style: Voice becomes even more tender. Opens with a slight smile in the tone. Slower, more labored breathing — age showing gently. Trails into silence, lost in the gentleness of that memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ケリー首相の演説に感銘されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Prime Minister Kerry's speech really moved you when you were young, didn't it dear?
lines.style: Soft, closing warmth. She's let him sit in his memories long enough. Quieter breath, gentle smile throughout. No rush. This question is a benediction, not a challenge.
